metadata.source: AER Default Market Offer Final Determinations 2019-20 to 2026-27
metadata.notes: Annual reference prices in AUD for representative customers. Flat rate tariff. Usage assumptions vary by zone and have changed across determinations.

dmo5_usage_assumptions_kwh.note: DMO 5 (2023-24) used a 366-day year, adjusting all usage assumptions

metadata.small_business_note: Small business usage assumption changed from 20,000 kWh to 10,000 kWh at DMO 4 (2022-23). Earlier SB prices are not comparable and are excluded. SB series begins at DMO 4.

cpi_deflators.description: CPI All Groups Weighted Average of Eight Capital Cities, June quarter index chained from Jun 2019 = 100. Used to deflate nominal DMO prices to 2019-20 dollars.
cpi_deflators.source: ABS Consumer Price Index, Australia (cat. 6401.0). June quarter annual percentage changes applied cumulatively from a Jun 2019 base.
cpi_deflators.note_dmo8: Jun 2026 figure uses the ABS June quarter 2026 CPI annual change of 3.9% (published 26 August 2026).

approximate_customers.description: Approximate total customers per distribution zone, for customer-weighted averages. Figures are rounded from DNSP regulatory proposals, annual reports and AER snapshots (2023-25 vintage).

sources.Endeavour Energy: Endeavour Energy 2025-30 Regulatory Proposal Overview, January 2024 (1.08 million)
sources.Essential Energy: Essential Energy Annual Report 2025 (over 900,000 electricity customers)
sources.Energex: Energex 2025-30 Regulatory Proposal Overview, January 2024 (close to 1.6 million)

data_sources.residential_2022-23: AER DMO 4 (2022–23) Final Determination, Table 2.1 (p. 7); F2022L00738 as-made instrument (prices at s 7, usage at s 5)
data_sources.residential_2024-25: AER DMO 6 (2024–25) Revised Final Determination, Table 2.1 (p. 6)
data_sources.residential_2026-27: AER DMO 8 (2026–27) Final Determination, Table 2.1 (p. 7); Information Kit (p. 4)
data_sources.small_business_2022-23: AER DMO 4 (2022–23) Final Determination, Table 2.1 (p. 7); F2022L00738 as-made instrument (prices at s 7, usage at s 5)
data_sources.small_business_2024-25: AER DMO 6 (2024–25) Revised Final Determination, Table 2.1 (p. 6)
data_sources.small_business_2026-27: AER DMO 8 (2026–27) Final Determination, Table 2.2 (p. 8); Information Kit (p. 5)
data_sources.sa_wholesale_costs: AER DMO 8 (2026–27) Final Determination, s 1.2 – SA wholesale costs fell less than other regions because of high-priced FCAS events in July and August 2025

cost_components.description: Share ranges of DMO price by component, as published in AER information kits. The AER publishes ranges across distribution zones, not single midpoint values.

standing_offer_customers.description: Number of customers on standing offers and share of total customer base, from AER determination Table 3.1 series (DMO 4 through DMO 8). SE Queensland figures are approximate — extrapolated from all of Queensland by excluding Ergon Energy customers (per Table 3.1 notes).

regional_residential_latest.note: Regional residential standing offer counts derived from DMO 7 and DMO 8 Table 3.1
